Announcement by hon. governor, central province
Delegation of power under the Co-operative Societies Statute No. 10 of 1990 of the Central Provincial Council as amended by the Co-operative Societies (Amendment)
Statute No. 4 of 1993 of the Central Provincial Council in accordance with the
Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

I, S. B. S. Abayakoon, as the Governor of the Central Provincial Council, in accordance with the powers vested in me by the Article 154(c) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, in terms of sub-sections 2(2), 2(4) of Co-operative Societies Statute No. 10 of 1990 of the Central Provincial Council as amended by the Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Statute No. 04 of 1993 of the Central Provincial, Council I hereby declare that powers referred in column 111 will be delegated to the Deputy Commissioner of Co-operative Development (Sri Lanka Administrative Service) of the Central Provincial Council referred to in column No. 1 below with effect from the date specified in column 11.

Mr. B. M. P. S. B. Basnayake22.07.2024Powers of the Co-operative Societies Registrar under the Section No. 58, (Except the sub sections No. 2a,3,4,5) 59,60a of the Central Provincial Council Co-operative Societies Statute No. 10 of 1990, amended by the Central Provincial Council Co-operative Societies Statute No. 04 of 1993 and the regulations No. 43,48,49 (except the sub sections No. 12b,c,d,e) 52,53 of in the Co-operative Societies Rules 1973.
Professor, S. B. S. Abayakoon, the Governor, Central Province.EOG 12 - 0084
